author: Linnaeus, 1766
status: 길잃은새, 지금까지 기록 10건 미만 · 기록을 검토하는 중
habitat: 바닷가 도시의 공원, 섬, 저수지 주변

months.note: 국내에서 기록된 달이다(2020년 이후 관찰 기록).

summary: 2020년 이후 군산 옥도면의 섬과 부산, 제주도, 울산 등지에서 몇 차례 관찰된 길잃은새로, 배를 타고 들어왔을 가능성 등 기원이 분명하지 않아 새와 생명의 터가 기록을 검토하고 있다. 원래 중앙아시아와 인도 아대륙에서 인도차이나, 중국 남부에 이르는 지역의 텃새이고, 사람이 옮겨 놓아 세계 여러 곳에 퍼졌다. 농경지와 마을, 도시의 트인 곳에서 무리 지어 땅 위를 걸으며 곤충과 열매 등 무엇이든 먹고, 지붕이나 건물 틈 같은 인공 구조물에 둥지를 트는 일이 많다.

points.en: bare bright yellow skin behind and below the eye
black head, neck and upper breast
white undertail coverts and white tail tip

sexes.text: 암수 생김새가 같고 수컷이 조금 크다.

young: 어린새는 어른새보다 칙칙하고 갈색을 띠며, 머리와 멱이 검지 않고 광택 없는 갈색이다.

art.subject: Common Myna (Acridotheres tristis), adult (sexes alike): head, neck and upper breast glossy black, sharply set off from the warm chocolate-brown body; a bare, bright yellow patch of skin behind and below the eye; back and wings brown, with a white patch at the base of the primaries showing as a small white mark on the closed wing; tail black with white tips to the outer feathers; lower belly, vent and undertail coverts white. Bright yellow bill; dark eye; bright yellow legs.
art.pose: walking on short grass, side view, head up
art.scene: Korean farmland edge with short grass and bare soil in spring; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view walking upright on short grass, head up: black head, neck and upper breast sharply set off from the dark brown body, bare bright yellow skin behind and below the eye, stout yellow bill, brown wings with a small white patch on the primaries, white lower belly and undertail coverts, dark tail tipped white, yellow legs

adult, in flight seen squarely from below: rounded wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, white underwing coverts, large white patches at the base of the primaries, black head, throat and upper breast, yellow bill, dark brown belly and flanks, white undertail coverts, dark tail tipped white, yellow feet tucked under the tail
art.build: Stocky starling, a little larger and stouter than the White-cheeked Starling, with an upright stance; slightly flat crown, no crest. Bill yellow, fairly stout and slightly decurved, shorter than the head. Legs long and strong, yellow; walks with a swagger rather than hopping. Tail of medium length, rounded. In flight large white patches at the base of the primaries flash on rounded dark wings, the underwing coverts are white and the tail corners white.
avoid: Do not paint it all black with a forehead tuft and a pale bill; that is the Crested Myna (Acridotheres cristatellus).
Do not omit the bare yellow skin around the eye.
Do not paint pale spots or streaks like a starling.
Do not extend the black onto the belly or back; only the head, neck and upper breast are black.
